title: CAM-117 Half B/B-2: plan-runner gates cluster (generic operator-decision gate + cam resume + BLOCK re-plan loop + plan_approval=operator + in-progress-work conflict)
description:
Deferred second half of CAM-151 (CAM-117 Half B). CAM-151 B-1 ships the MAKE-LIVE core (phase enum single-source-of-truth in .claude/cam-loop.local.md with active derived from phase==='implementing'; wire runPlanPhase into the sidecar outer loop for the auto/happy path; `cam plan N` becomes a phase:planning signal-writer; cam-plan.md reduced to a thin phase-signal stub; keep Half A's escalate-to-operator on auditor BLOCK, NO auto re-plan yet).

B-2 (this issue) adds the GATES cluster on top of the live plan-runner:

1. Generic deterministic operator-decision gate primitive: phase:awaiting-operator + a pause object { gate, options[], context }; the sidecar notifies the orchestrator pane with context+options and waits (never auto-decides). Designed GENERIC (gate discriminator + options[] + context) because CAM-149 (ship-runner pauses) and CAM-139 (drainer kill-switch) reuse the exact same primitive.

2. `cam resume <decision>` CLI thin-proxy: writes the decision to the loop file; the sidecar polls, validates the decision against the ACTIVE gate's options (rejecting invalid with a clear error), and resumes deterministically. Signal is source of truth; orchestrator only narrates.

3. Deterministic BLOCK->re-plan loop: on auditor BLOCK, re-spawn the planner with the auditor findings (read from plan-verdict-report.json) injected into its prompt (CAM-37 mirror), capped at 2 rounds via a named constant; HALT to operator on non-convergence, NEVER auto-branch/flip an un-approved PRD (unlike review's MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT which promotes+continues).

4. plan_approval=operator full-PRD gate: on auditor APPROVE in operator mode, pause via the generic gate with the FULL audited PRD summary as context (options approve/reject); approve->commit+branch+flip phase:implementing, reject->halt to phase:idle+notify. Deliberate behavior change: reviews the full audited PRD, not the pre-PRD sketch.

5. in-progress-work conflict gate: detect deterministically at runPlanPhase start (prd.json with a passes:false non-operator story OR being on a cam/* branch); escalate via the generic gate with options continue/ship/abandon; continue->phase:implementing, abandon->deterministic clean (rm handoff.json + discard prd/branch state)+proceed, ship->delegate /cam-ship (becomes phase:shipping when CAM-149 lands).

Depends on CAM-151 (B-1). Split rationale: jobSize-3+, would overflow the 3-round review cap (mirrors CAM-117/CAM-111 + prd-size-vs-review-convergence lesson). Full grilled design already lives in CAM-151's spec block. Specify via /cam-spec when reached.
